replay.compare: what the phone holds of each delivered state, whole: its rows (items) and transcriptHasOlder; with the byte counts, page counts, staleness answers and full-output read-backs each case records. Node's delta-wire text is Node's transport, not K1's
replay.entry: In K1 the phone resumes a thread (thread/resume with phone-view.ts VIEW_WINDOW) and pages it with thread/items/list (mixdog-app-protocol methods.rs:185; mixdog-core-session reads.rs items_list), folds the feed into rows (packages/protocol-client session-state.ts, rows.ts), and shows them through its own transcript window, implemented on this branch: apps/desktop/src/main/remote-phone-transcript.ts createPhoneTranscript over remote-transcript-window.ts phoneTranscriptView (first page within REMOTE_TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_ITEMS / REMOTE_TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_BYTES, oversized tool outputs cut, pages of at most 512 rows within DESKTOP_TRANSCRIPT_PAGE_BYTES, Show full output through remoteToolOutput), wired into the phone chat adapter (apps/desktop/src/renderer/remote-protocol-chat.ts ChatShared.transcript: prefetchSession pages it, readTranscriptItem reads the full output). Replay: benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/replay-remote-transcript-window.mjs, run by mixdog-core-session src/session/client_chain_replay_tests.rs, which stores each case's rows in a thread of a SessionDirectory (the product's RecordTranscript) and answers the phone's resume, feed and items/list reads in one chain.

cases.a page revealed above a short first page: replayed through the phone's window over the recorded rows as its fold (tool rows: the K1 fold merges a run of finished tool rows into one aggregate card, rows.ts mergeToolRows, so 16 separate shell rows are no fold a thread's feed gives); the older page is read through the window's `older` read
cases.a phone's first page stays within its by: replayed through the core chain (rows stored in a thread, resumed, folded, windowed)
cases.live rows append past the first page; ol: replayed through the core chain, with viewIsStale (apps/desktop/src/main/remote-view-staleness.ts) over the core's newest rows
cases.a phone page reveals at most 512 rows a: replayed through the core chain (pages read with thread/items/list)
cases.an oversized newest tool row goes with i: replayed through the phone's window over the recorded aggregate row as its fold (a hand-made aggregate is no fold of a thread's feed), the full outputs read back through the window's output read (remoteToolOutput)
cases.a compacted live session whose runtime s: replayed through the phone's window over the recorded rows: the fold is the newest VIEW_WINDOW rows, the older ones read as each page asks (the core keeps its whole log: Node's spill buffer has no K1 counterpart)

normalised.live rows append past the first page; ol: the new desktop row for staleWhenNewDesktopRow carries text: Node's row had none, and the core shows no empty prompt row; viewIsStale reads only a row's id, kind and device
normalised.a phone page reveals at most 512 rows a: the 2000 rows are posted 50 at a time: one thread/inheritedRows/append of 2000 rows fails the thread StorageIndeterminate (one plan over the 64-record durability window, actor.rs pump) — a core limit reported to Lead, not a value of the case
normalised.a compacted live session whose runtime s: steps compared whole up to Node's spill seam (the page crossing from live rows into spilled ones stopped short of its limit, loadLiveTranscriptHead); after it each K1 page must reveal the 64 rows asked for or reach the first row; the final state is compared whole
